propositions: caused_by edges must be distinguishable as provenance-marked 'derived' (from blame auto-derivation) or 'explicit' (operator/agent-supplied) to enable weighted escape-rate metrics

An optional 'provenance' field on caused_by LINK event payload with enum values 'derived' or 'explicit' marks the attribution origin, while legacy unmarked events read as unknown without schema migration

Both transition_close._apply_caused_by and add_dependency must populate the provenance marker: 'explicit' for operator-supplied --caused-by flags and rebar link calls, 'derived' for blame-derived culprits
The reducer process_link copies provenance onto dep entries present-only, preserving backward compatibility so old unmarked events replay to identical dep shapes
bug_trends metrics gain a bug_caused_by_provenance dimension reporting explicit/derived/unknown edge counts, enabling consumers to weight proven attributions above guesses
